title: Rules.
bodyText: The office of the lieutenant governor shall adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 to implement this chapter, including setting a fee for the issuance of an apostille or a non-apostille certification.
bodyHtml: [§27J-4]  Rules.  The office of the lieutenant governor shall adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 to implement this chapter, including setting a fee for the issuance of an apostille or a non-apostille certification. [L 2024, c 133, pt of §1]
